Name: Death Tweaks
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod causes items dropped on death to be stored in a tombstone at the location of death.

There are options to cause all items to be dropped or no items to be dropped.

Money lost can be modified by a multiplier in the options and the tombstone can also be disabled.


[b][size=5]Notes[/size][/b]

Tombstones persist only for the current day and will disappear the next day, causing all items to be lost.

If the player dies in the Skull Cavern, the map may change the next time the player returns, so the tombstone might be on a different tile.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
